title: Virtual screening of natural products targeting ubiquitin-specific protease 7.
authors: Li, Hongju; Sun, Yujie; Yin, Hua; Zhang, Yuzhu; Yu, Junhong; Hou, Ning; Wang, Peng; Liang, Huicong; Xie, Aowei; Wang, Xiaohong; Dong, Jianjun; Xu, Ximing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物靶向去泛素化酶USP7的虚拟筛选与抑制机制，对象为蛋白质-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Ubiquitin-specific protease 7 (USP7) is a promising prognostic and druggable target for cancer therapy. Inhibition of USP7 can activate the MDM2-P53 signaling pathway, thereby promoting cancer cell apoptosis. This study based on watvina molecular docking of virtual screening method and biological evaluation found the new USP7 inhibitors targeting catalytic active site. Three hits were screened from 3760 natural products and validated as USP7 inhibitors by enzymatic and kinetic assays. The IC(50) values of scutellarein (Scu), semethylzeylastera (DML) and salvianolic acid C (SAC) were 3.017, 6.865 and 8.495 muM, respectively. Further, we reported that the hits could downregulate MDM2 and activate p53 signal pathway in HCT116 cells. Molecular dynamics simulation was used to investigate the binding mechanism of USP7 to Scu, the compound with the best performance, which formed stable contact with Val296, Gln297, Phe409, Tyr465 and Tyr514. These interactions are essential for maintaining the biological activity of Scu. Three natural products are suitable as lead compounds for the development of novel USP7 inhibitors, especially anti-colon cancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 泛素特异性蛋白酶7（USP7）是癌症治疗中一个有前景的预后和药物靶点。抑制USP7可激活MDM2-P53信号通路，从而促进癌细胞凋亡。本研究基于watvina分子对接的虚拟筛选方法和生物学评价，发现了靶向催化活性位点的新型USP7抑制剂。从3760种天然产物中筛选出三个命中化合物，并通过酶学和动力学实验验证其为USP7抑制剂。野黄芩素（Scu）、去甲基泽拉斯特酮（DML）和丹酚酸C（SAC）的IC(50)值分别为3.017、6.865和8.495 μM。进一步，我们报道了这些命中化合物在HCT116细胞中能够下调MDM2并激活p53信号通路。采用分子动力学模拟研究了USP7与性能最佳的化合物Scu的结合机制，该化合物与Val296、Gln297、Phe409、Tyr465和Tyr514形成稳定接触。这些相互作用对于维持Scu的生物活性至关重要。这三种天然产物适合作为开发新型USP7抑制剂，特别是抗结肠癌药物的先导化合物。
